title: Tree-Ring Watermarks: Fingerprints for Diffusion Images that are Invisible and Robust
limitations: Fourier invariance is heuristic through nonlinear model. Distribution changes and multi-key limitations. No lightweight DCT detector demonstrated.

title: Gaussian Shading: Provable Performance-Lossless Image Watermarking for Diffusion Models
limitations: Assumes private diffusion model; stream key management required. Repeated-key or nonce misuse invalidates security reasoning. Reported .4 is sign flip rate, not regeneration strength.

title: An undetectable watermark for generative image models
limitations: Sec3.2/C.3 finite experimental parameters do not satisfy strict pseudorandomness proof bounds. Detection is inversion dependent. FID is distributional, not paired perceptual preservation.

title: RingID: Rethinking Tree-Ring Watermarking for Enhanced Multi-Key Identification
limitations: Severe crop/scale identification failure remains. Larger key spaces reduce robustness/quality. No content-bound identity or image-only DCT extraction.

title: ROBIN: Robust and Invisible Watermarks for Diffusion Models with Adversarial Optimization
limitations: Still needs diffusion model, inversion, injection point and watermark key; .531s is hardware-specific. Main table ordinary transformations is not a regeneration sweep. Hiding prompt during inversion hurts recovery.

title: Hidden in the Noise: Two-Stage Robust Watermarking for Images
limitations: Search bank and inversion cost are essential side information. Paper regen settings do not directly equal local img2img strength .4. Finite/reused initial-noise pool affects multi-query distribution.

title: Gaussian Shannon: High-Precision Diffusion Model Watermarking Based on Communication
limitations: Preprint; ordinary-noise averages are not T3 guarantee. LDPC parity success alone is not cryptographic authentication. Dependent errors challenge iid communication bounds.
